## Bioinformatics consulting

- Analysis of microbiome and other omics data
- Statistical analysis and reporting of results
- Reproducible analysis workflows in R and Python
- Help with R and Bioconductor: code review and package development

## Training

- Workshops and courses on microbiome data analysis with R and Bioconductor
- Training for research groups and companies, adjusted to your data and level
- I am a certified [Carpentries](https://carpentries.org) instructor

I have taught at EMBL-EBI, the National University of Singapore and Bioconductor
conferences in Europe, the USA and Australia, as well as at Finnish universities and
other organisations.
See [past workshops and courses](presentations.qmd).

## Data analytics for business

- Data analysis and reporting to support business decisions
- Business intelligence tools and custom data software

I have a master's degree in economics and business administration (accounting and
finance), so I understand both the data and the business side.

## Example project

For a customer that specialises in purchase analytics, I developed Python software.
It fetches purchase data, curates it automatically and stores it in a database. It then
analyses and visualises the data. The goal was to see where the money flows and what
organisations spend it on.
